note: Adapted from the species-level description (Imago Female, fig. 4; Soldier, figs. 5, 6) and TABLE 2 and TABLE 3 in Krishna & Araujo's revision of the genus Neocapritermes (Bulletin of the American Museum of Natural History, vol. 138), the original in English. The alate section records only the female, the original heading being Imago Female. In TABLE 2 the row "hind tibia length" gives the range 1.84—1.94 mm but the mean 1.19 mm, which falls outside the range and is evidently an error in the book or in the OCR; it is reproduced here and flagged, not smoothed over. In the soldier section the phrase "pronotum 0.61 of head width" is the original ratio, not a measurement. The Comparisons following the two sections (with N. opacus, N. taracua, N. bodkini, N. braziliensis, N. parvus and N. araguaia) are not included.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head, thorax and abdominal tergites light brown; wing veins brownish; mouthparts, labrum, mandibles (except the black tips), antennae, legs and the thoracic and some abdominal sternites pale yellow; some sutures and some abdominal sternites brownish. Head with very few fine, erect, fairly long bristles; labrum with a few longer hairs; cervical sclerites with numerous short bristles; pronotum hairy, with numerous long and medium-length bristles and denser decumbent short pubescence; mesonotal and metanotal pubescence sparser; wing scales strongly hairy, the veins with regularly arranged oblique hairs, denser towards the tip, the membrane with extremely small hairs visible only in lateral view; the longitudinal ridge of the fore coxa with a conspicuous row of bristles of unequal length (some extremely long) and sparse long bristles on the inner side; mid and hind coxae with sparse bristles of unequal size on the ridge and on the inner side; abdominal tergites and sternites densely covered with decumbent short pubescence and with numerous medium-length recumbent bristles; the intersegmental membranes of the pleural region densely covered with short soft hairs. In lateral view the top line of the head is straight and the disc slightly concave; fontanelle plate circular or slightly pear-shaped, pale, with a dark sclerotised spot in the centre. Compound eyes very prominent and convex, almost circular, straight only along the posterolateral stretch. Ocelli elongate-oval, the lower margin almost straight. Antennae 17-segmented, segments 3 and 4 very small, together as long as segment 2, segment 5 slightly longer than segment 4, segment 6 slightly thicker than segment 7, segments 8—14 progressively longer, segments 15—17 nearly equal, the last segment oval-elongate. Pronotum almost flat, with only a slight transverse concavity near the anterior margin; anterior margin straight, anterolateral angles rounded, the sides and the posterior margin forming a semicircle, the middle of the posterior margin with a slight notch. Posterior margins of the mesonotum and metanotum deeply concave, the outer angles of the latter projecting beyond the notch as short, regular, obtuse points. Measurements (4 alates; the two columns in the original are, in order, range and mean): head capsule length in lateral view 1.12—1.22 mm, 1.17 mm; head width including the eyes 1.58—1.66 mm, 1.63 mm; eye diameter 0.54—0.59 mm, 0.56 mm; distance from the eye to the lower margin 0.03—0.04 mm, 0.04 mm; ocellus longest diameter 0.20—0.26 mm, 0.22 mm; ocellus shortest diameter 0.13—0.15 mm, 0.14 mm; distance from the ocellus to the eye 0.05—0.06 mm, 0.05 mm; fontanelle plate long diameter 0.10—0.12 mm, 0.11 mm; pronotum maximum length 0.92—0.97 mm, 0.95 mm; pronotum median length 0.90—0.92 mm, 0.91 mm; pronotum maximum width 1.43—1.48 mm, 1.46 mm; hind tibia length 1.84—1.94 mm (the mean in the original is given as 1.19 mm for this line, incompatible with the range, see the note); forewing length from the suture 12.70—13.50 mm, 13.02 mm; forewing width 3.19—3.30 mm, 3.22 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head brownish; margins of the postmentum brown; antennae and mouthparts brownish; mandibles shiny black; labrum yellow; thorax and legs straw-coloured; abdomen dirty white. Head with a few scattered, long, fine, colourless, erect bristles, denser near the anterolateral angles, absent ventrally; postmentum with 2 bristles at each anterior angle; pronotum with sparse long, erect, fairly dark and fairly stout bristles; legs almost hairless, only the longitudinal ridge of the fore coxa with a few longer hairs; abdomen with numerous fairly stout, fairly dark bristles of 2 lengths. Head elongate (1.9 times as long as wide, and extremely slightly longer than the left mandible, 1.1 times), sides parallel, with an extremely slight narrowing only behind the raised anterolateral angles; in dorsal view the top is straight, sloping down in front of the fontanelle, rounded behind; postclypeus strongly distorted, its left side drawn out into a small, regular, stout, basally wide spine-like process; fontanelle minute, not lying in a pit. Antennae extremely slightly longer than the left mandible, 16-segmented, segment 4 the shortest, slightly longer than segment 3, segments 5—12 progressively longer (segments 8—12 proportionally longer), segments 13—15 shorter than the preceding ones and decreasing, segment 16 oval-elongate and as long as segment 15. Labrum broad or slightly narrowed in the middle, the anterior margin concave, with a small tubercle or a broad swelling between 2 conspicuous lateral lobes. Mandibles proportionally very long, only slightly shorter than the head. In lateral view the left mandible is broadly curved over nearly half its length and extends in an S-shape into the elongate apical club. The right mandible is straight in lateral view, slightly curved only at the tip, shallowly concave above, the tip drawn out into a fairly sharp point. The distal half of the postmentum is elongate and club-shaped; the distal 1/6 widens slightly to the sides, with the sides converging towards the shallowly convex anterior margin; the proximal half has slightly concave sides and a strongly divergent base; the posterior margin shallowly convex. Pronotum 0.61 of the head width, the anterior lobe broadly semicircular and slightly longer than the posterior lobe, its anterior margin with an almost imperceptible median notch, the posterior lobe broadly semicircular with a slight trace of a notch in the middle of the posterior margin. Mesonotum transverse, sides rounded, posterior margin straight. Metanotum wider than the pronotum, the sides slightly angulate, the posterior margin broadly and shallowly concave, with a shallow transverse concavity in the distal half. Mid tibiae with 1 or 2 spines, slightly stouter than normal bristles. Measurements (14 soldiers; the three columns in the original are, in order, holotype, range and mean): head capsule length in lateral view 3.60 mm, 3.10—4.30 mm, 3.56 mm; maximum head width 1.88 mm, 1.75—2.20 mm, 1.87 mm; maximum head height 1.60 mm, 1.50—1.88 mm, 1.61 mm; left mandible length 3.25 mm, 2.80—3.60 mm, 3.19 mm; right mandible length 3.00 mm, 2.50—3.05 mm, 2.86 mm; postmentum maximum width 0.60 mm, 0.50—0.60 mm, 0.55 mm; postmentum minimum width 0.30 mm, 0.28—0.35 mm, 0.30 mm; postmentum length 2.30 mm, 2.10—3.10 mm, 2.44 mm; pronotum median length 0.60 mm, 0.60—0.78 mm, 0.64 mm; pronotum maximum length 0.65 mm, 0.60—0.78 mm, 0.65 mm; pronotum maximum width 1.15 mm, 1.10—1.33 mm, 1.16 mm; hind tibia length 1.50 mm, 1.30—1.70 mm, 1.48 mm.
